protected_invariants.heading: Purpose
protected_invariants.text: Design, launch and oversee a multi-agent crew in any agent harness (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, Gemini CLI, or any harness that can start sub-agents and read and write files) that runs a long job to a defined goal against acceptance criteria fixed up front: a lead, workers, fresh verifiers, a safety watch and an independent drift auditor, with change control. Use when the user types /engos-orchestration-crew (with or without a command such as help, design, launch, status, end) or wants a long, checkable, multi-agent job (an A/B evaluation, QA of a built system, an audit or a migration) run unattended with no drift. Do not use for short or single-agent tasks.

protected_invariants.heading: Kiro (Kiro CLI and IDE)
protected_invariants.text: | Timers | Hooks fire on events only, never on a clock, and a background `sleep` waking an idle agent is *(unconfirmed)*. Run each member from an outside loop or cron that re-invokes `kiro-cli chat --resume-id <id> --no-interactive "read your inbox"` every 600 seconds. Count only observed lead wakes meeting gate 5 |

protected_invariants.heading: Kiro Crew (the KiroCrew app)
protected_invariants.text: | Messaging | Use inbox files for assignments. File-writing members append `status.md` lines. Monitors return read-only session output to the designer; block if unavailable. `session_send(target, message)` can nudge a member and `session_read_message` reads one back. The stock `kirocrew-team-lead` agent allows `session_create`, `session_read_message` and `session_status`, but not `session_send`. `send_message` goes to the user (Slack, DM, dashboard), never to crew members |

protected_invariants.heading: Kiro Crew (the KiroCrew app)
protected_invariants.text: | Deny rules | A custom agent JSON per role with `toolsSettings` (`shell.denyByDefault`, `deniedCommands`, `write.fallbackAction: "deny"`), enforced at Kiro Crew's pre-tool-use gate. The stock `kirocrew--readonly` agent is for side turns only and cannot be started as a member |

protected_invariants.heading: Codex (Codex CLI)
protected_invariants.text: | Messaging | Use inbox files for assignments. File-writing members append `status.md` lines. Monitors return read-only session output to the designer; block if unavailable. `codex queue --thread <id or name> --message "<text>"` queues a message for an existing session *(listed in help, not run)*. A parent reaches its own sub-agents with `send_input` |

protected_invariants.heading: Codex (Codex CLI)
protected_invariants.text: | Timers | A `sleep` tool that ends early on new input exists for some models only *(unconfirmed for the model in use)*. Another candidate is an authorized outside loop or cron running `codex exec resume <id> "read your inbox"` every 600 seconds. Count only observed lead wakes meeting gate 5 |

protected_invariants.heading: Codex (Codex CLI)
protected_invariants.text: | Deny rules | Start the safety watch and drift auditor with `-s read-only`, others with `-s workspace-write`, always explicitly, because a user config may default to `danger-full-access`. Command deny rules: `.rules` files with `prefix_rule(pattern=[...], decision="forbidden")` in `~/.codex/rules/`, or `<repo>/.codex/rules/` for a trusted project. Sub-agents inherit the parent's sandbox. Never pass `--ignore-rules`. Whether rules hold under `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` is *(unconfirmed)* |

protected_invariants.heading: Gemini CLI
protected_invariants.text: | Messaging | Use inbox files for assignments. File-writing members append `status.md` lines. Monitors return read-only session output to the designer; block if unavailable |

protected_invariants.heading: Gemini CLI
protected_invariants.text: | Timers | The shell tool can run a background process, but no wake on its completion is documented, and hooks fire on CLI events only. Run each member from an outside loop or cron that re-runs `gemini -p --resume <id> "read your inbox"` every 600 seconds *(flag combination not run)*. Count only observed lead wakes meeting gate 5 |
